description.en-US: A shared visual language for newly authored AUIP apps; each app keeps its own content and layout.
description.zh-CN: 为新创作的 AUIP 应用提供共享的视觉语言；各应用保留自己的内容和布局。

description.en-US: After a backend restart, provide the style guide and CSS for future AUIP creation. Existing apps keep their design; explicit user design requests take priority.
description.zh-CN: 后端重启后，为今后的 AUIP 创建提供样式指南和 CSS；已有应用保留其设计，明确的用户设计要求优先。
